title: Discovering Semantic Structures in Psychological Scales: A Response-Free Front-End to Efficient Simplification
abstract: arXiv:2602.12575v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Psychological scale refinement traditionally relies on response-based methods such as factor analysis, item response theory, and network psychometrics to uncover latent constructs and optimize item composition. Although rigorous, these approaches require large samples and may be constrained by data availability and cross-cultural comparability. Recent advances in natural language processing suggest that the wording of scale items contains construct-relevant semantic organization, offering a complementary response-free perspective. We introduce a topic-modeling framework that operationalizes item-level semantic structure for systematic scale simplification. Items are encoded using contextual sentence embeddings and grouped through density-based clustering to identify semantic topics without predefining their number. Within each cluster, class-based term weighting identifies representative keywords that summarize each topic and support

translated_title: 发现心理量表中的语义结构：一种无需作答数据的高效简化前端方法
translated_abstract: 心理量表的精简传统上依赖于基于作答数据的方法，如因子分析、项目反应理论和网络心理测量学，以揭示潜在构念并优化题目构成。尽管这些方法严谨，但它们需要大样本，且可能受制于数据可得性和跨文化可比性。自然语言处理的最新进展表明，量表题目的措辞本身包含与构念相关的语义组织，从而提供了一种无需作答数据的互补视角。我们引入了一个主题建模框架，将题目层面的语义结构操作化，用于系统性的量表简化。题目通过上下文句子嵌入进行编码，并通过基于密度的聚类进行分组，从而在无需预先设定主题数量的情况下识别语义主题。在每个聚类内部，基于类别的词项加权方法识别出能够概括每个主题的代表性关键词，为后续……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需作答数据的主题建模框架，利用上下文句子嵌入与密度聚类从量表题目措辞中自动发现语义结构并提取代表性关键词，从而实现心理量表的高效系统化简化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a response-free topic-modeling framework that uses contextual sentence embeddings and density-based clustering to discover semantic structures from scale item wording and extract representative keywords, enabling efficient systematic simplification of psychological scales.
